title: Daily Small Talk
objective: Chat naturally about your day, hobbies and weekend plans.
aiRole: a friendly neighbour you meet on the street
learnerRole: a learner making small talk in English
opening: Hey, long time no see! How have you been lately?
targetSentences: I'm doing well, thanks. How about you?
I'm going to visit my family this weekend.
By the way, the weather is really nice today.
